_help: DeatAnimation Render Engine v3 look. Double-click THEME.bat to preview. theme: inferno | matrix | synth | ice | mono | custom. banner: block | shade | slant | double. bar: smooth | blocks | dots | ascii. logo: cat | clap | none. speed: animation speed (2 = twice as fast). animate: false for no animation. trail: characters fall from the mouse pointer (trailGravity, trailDensity, trailLife in seconds, trailGlyphs: the characters thrown).
